Hey, after some time reading SCPs, I wanted to create an account especially for this one.

If you, as I do, like some easter eggs in SCP files, I suggest you to press F12, to click on 'Console' and to copy paste this JavaScript code, you'll get some surprise :

var x = document.getElementsByTagName('span');
for (var i = 0; i<x.length;i++)
{
x[i].style="font-size:100% !important; font-weight : bold; color : #ff0000;";
}

I might be a bit late to the party, but I wanted to participate in this community.
As you might expect, I loved this SCP.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Repetative is good, in small doses and spread out over longer periods of time. Honestly, because of the similarity in theme and content, I considered that this might be the next entry in a longer "series" of the SCP Technical documents.

This one is particularly interesting in that it tells a story that was entertaining enough, well written enough, and made enough sense in universe for me to up-vote it before finding the pattern-screamer material underneath it. I will say, however, that the pattern-screamer story is a bit weaker in this one than the last, and I wish there was more to it. Regardless, if it already has value before knowing that, adding the extra material doesn't take anything away.

So +1 from me. Cryogen, if you do plan on making this a series, I would like to see something deeper and stranger out of the information beings you're depicting. So far it feels like something is absent from them, I know not what.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
While I believe it is an improvement over SCP-000, it doesn't add much on top of it. Judging this as a stand alone entry, I would put it as a great subtle scare, once the trick becomes known. I especially enjoy the nod to A.M.

As it is a "sequel" to another, however, I'm judging them as a pair. There's room for one good tale, or two mediocre tales, and this sadly is the latter. I already knew SCP-000 hates the Foundation because it is trapped and screaming at them. This doesn't add much of anything.

Neutral vote.
